description: Neo4j JavaScript/TypeScript Driver v6 — driver lifecycle, executeQuery, managed transactions (executeRead/executeWrite), session.run, Integer handling, JSON serialization, record access, async/await patterns, TypeScript types, error handling, and connection setup for Node.js and browser. Use when writing JS/TS code that connects to Neo4j — neo4j.driver(), executeQuery, executeRead, executeWrite, session.run, neo4j.int, record.get, Integer, BookmarkManager, bolt://, neo4j+s://. Does NOT handle Cypher query authoring — use neo4j-cypher-skill. Does NOT cover driver version migration — use neo4j-migration-skill.
